WITH RaceResults AS (
    SELECT 
        r.raceId,
        res.time,
        res.position,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceId ORDER BY res.position) AS position_rank
    FROM 
        races r
    JOIN 
        results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE 
        r.year = 2008 AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix' AND res.statusId IS NOT NULL
),
Champion AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 10) AS REAL) AS champion_time
    FROM RaceResults
    WHERE position_rank = 1
),
LastDriver AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) +
        CAST(SUBSTR(time, 10) AS REAL) AS last_driver_time
    FROM RaceResults
    WHERE position_rank = (SELECT MAX(position_rank) FROM RaceResults)
)
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN last_driver_time IS NOT NULL AND champion_time IS NOT NULL THEN 
            (CAST((last_driver_time - champion_time) AS REAL) / last_driver_time) * 100
        ELSE 
            NULL 
    END AS faster_percentage
FROM 
    Champion, LastDriver;	----- bird -----	formula_1
